maltodextrin.info: High glycemic index, can cause spikes in blood sugar.

sugar.info: High intake is linked to obesity, type 2 diabetes, and heart disease.

water.info: Essential for life and generally safe.

palm oil.info: High in saturated fats and environmental concerns regarding production.

salt.info: Essential in small amounts, but high intake can lead to high blood pressure.

aspartame.info: Artificial sweetener with controversial health studies.

citric acid.info: Naturally occurring acid used as a preservative and flavor enhancer.

lecithin.info: A fat that is essential in the cells of the body.
